summary.en: Closing the last Desktop window marks the member Offline immediately instead of waiting for presence TTL.
summary.zh: 关闭最后一个 Desktop 窗口会立即将成员标为 Offline，而不再等待 presence TTL。

compatibilityExceptions.reason: Mobile does not own Desktop last-window close, the presence heartbeat client, or the Desktop Host presence close POST.
Platform HTTP already exposes presence close as a live-connection adapter; this delivery only makes Desktop call it on last-window close.
